1.consolidated_definition: Árbol de hasta 12 m de longitud, de tronco con corteza lisa, de color gris claro, hojas aovado-lanceoladas o elípticas, cuyo fruto maduro es de color azul oscuro o negro. (Lauraceae; Nectandra coriacea).
1.en_consolidated_definition: Tree reaching up to 12 m in length, with a trunk having smooth, light gray bark, ovate-lanceolate or elliptical leaves, and a fruit that is dark blue or black when mature (Lauraceae; Nectandra coriacea).
